subject: Your Netflix subscription renews on February 1
body:
Hi there,

This is a friendly reminder that your Netflix Premium subscription will automatically renew on February 1, 2024.

Plan: Premium (4K + HDR)
Price: $22.99/month
Next billing date: February 1, 2024
Payment method: Visa ending in 4242

To change your plan or update your payment method, visit netflix.com/youraccount.

Enjoy your streaming!

The Netflix Team
